featured_reviews.review_text:
Sharing my experience with Dr Pranjal Mittal, Thane West….
I, Vignesh Vishwanath, aged 37, had been facing a perennial problem on both my feet.
It appeared like a fungal infection between the fourth and fifth toes and symptom was extreme pain occasionally.
I do not even remember as to when I started getting this problem. It’s been years together. Each time the intensity of the pain increased, I used to see a doctor, mostly general practitioners. They treated assuming it to be a fungal infection. And coincidentally, the pain used to reduce every time after the treatment. However, I saw no reduction in the infection. The pain used to go away for a while and return after a couple of days. Since the intensity of pain those days otherwise was less and due to lack of time, I used to often ignore.
Earlier this year however, the pain grew manifold. I started finding it difficult to walk. I thought not to visit a GP this time as I never saw improvements, just the symptoms used to disappear each time.  No root cause analyses were being done. Hence, I instead thought of seeing a dermatologist.
I was just moving around in my locality looking for a dermatologist and I found Dr. Pranjal’s clinic.
I walked in and met Dr. Pranjal. I informed the problems I was facing. Even she initially thought it was a fungal infection and started her treatment, but in a different manner. I however hardly saw any improvement. Since I was working from home due to the lockdown, I again ignored.
However, after a couple of months, the pain increased. I was finding it difficult walking at home too.
I again visited the clinic. This time Dr Pranjal felt it wasn’t a fungal infection since the symptoms weren’t matching. She identified it to be a soft corn and began her treatment for it. It worked and I started noticing remarkable improvement within days.
It is now 90% recovered, absolutely no pain. Healing is in progress and I expect complete recovery in the next couple of days.
I did personally thank Dr Pranjal at her clinic for her right line of treatment. Nevertheless, I thought it was essential to write down my experience so that people know about it.
Moreover, about Dr Pranjal – She is polite, transparent but still handles situations very professionally. The best part I liked about her was that she accepted that her initial line of treatment was not correct. We hardly find people accepting mistakes these days.
An 18 year (perhaps even more) agony sorted out within days.
Thanks Dr Pranjal! And all the best to you!

Not every acne mark is a scar — and knowing the difference is where good treatment begins.

The marks left behind after acne aren't all the same. Red marks, brown pigmentation and true depressed scars each respond to different treatments, and starting the wrong one costs you time. The first step is always an accurate diagnosis from a qualified dermatologist.

For decades, our Juhu clinic has cared for generations of Mumbai families — looking closely at each person's skin and matching the treatment to what's actually there, informed by 50 years of documented dermatology behind Dr. Sheth's.

If acne marks have been bothering you, a consultation with a dermatologist in Juhu will tell you what type they are and what genuinely works for them — before you spend on anything else.

Hair loss has many causes, and the right treatment depends on identifying which one. At Dr. Sheth's Skin & Hair Clinics in Juhu, Mumbai, hair loss is assessed by qualified dermatologists who look for the underlying cause before recommending treatment. Common causes include genetic patterning (androgenetic alopecia), thyroid and hormonal changes, nutritional deficiencies such as low iron or ferritin, post-illness or postpartum shedding (telogen effluvium), and scalp conditions like dandruff or seborrhoeic dermatitis. Each is treated differently, so a proper diagnosis (medical history, scalp examination and, where needed, blood work) is the first step, not a one-size prescription. Our Juhu practice has cared for generations of Mumbai families over 50 years, and that documented clinical experience shapes every hair-loss plan. If you're noticing thinning, increased shedding or a widening part, an early consultation gives the clearest path forward. Book a hair-loss consultation at our Juhu clinic.

Most people seek treatment for hair loss when thinning becomes clearly visible. By then, the underlying scalp condition — chronic inflammation, seborrhoeic dermatitis, follicular miniaturisation — has often been progressing unaddressed for months.

At Dr. Sheth's Skin & Hair Clinics, we see hair and scalp concerns at every stage: from persistent dandruff and early shedding that does not respond to over-the-counter products, to more advanced thinning that may require procedural treatment such as GFC, PRP, or, where appropriate, a hair transplant carried out in-clinic by a specialist surgeon.

If you have been managing recurring scalp issues or progressive hair loss, a structured dermatologist evaluation is usually more efficient than cycling through products that do not address the root cause.

Our clinic is open Monday through Saturday. New patients begin with a dermatologist consultation — we assess your specific condition before recommending any treatment.

You've probably heard a hundred reasons your hair is thinning. Stress. Diet. Genetics. The shampoo your mother used.
Each could be true. Most of the time, only one is.
At our clinic, the first thing we do for a hair concern isn't a treatment — it's an evaluation. A scalp examination, a pull test, density assessment. Where it's needed, blood work for thyroid, ferritin, vitamin D. A trichoscope when the eye can't tell the full story.
It sounds clinical. It's actually the difference between a year of treatment that works and a year of treatment that doesn't. Hair loss from genetics looks similar to hair loss from a shedding episode looks similar to a scarring condition. The treatments are not similar at all.
Once we know what we're treating, we can talk about what to do about it — medical management, regenerative therapies like GFC, PRP, exosomes, or a transplant referral when that's the right call.

Overall, it was an extremely positive experience. We felt well-informed and confident about the next steps, and would wholeheartedly recommend Dr. Agni Bose to anyone seeking expert dermatological and hair care consultation.

featured_reviews.name: Sharon Sahai
featured_reviews.review_text:
The Skin Talk clinic is a reliable place to address all your skin problems.
Dr Pooja is an exceptionally good doctor.
She has helped me throughout with my skin conditions. She would give you the best treatment with the best results!
The staff here are highly trained and go out of their way to provide you excellent services. Very kind, courteous and highly professional at work!
Would definitely recommend to visit!

featured_reviews.name: shivangi tripathi
featured_reviews.review_text:
Dr. Pooja Chopra is excellent. I didn’t have any major skin concerns and was mainly looking for a few cosmetic procedures. She guided me really well and recommended treatments after carefully assessing my face, skin, and overall facial symmetry.

I initially wanted lip fillers, but she suggested lip boosters instead and it turned out to be the best decision. My lips look very natural, soft, and beautifully enhanced. I love the results. Her understanding of aesthetics is impressive, and she recommends what actually suits your face. I also got U-Laser done for my pores, and for the first time in my life, I can barely see them. The improvement in my skin texture has been amazing.

I don’t think I’ll ever visit any other dermatologist. I don’t even live in Mumbai, but I would genuinely travel just to see Dr. Pooja. I completely trust her judgment.

featured_reviews.name: Ayushi Saraf
featured_reviews.review_text:
I’ve been to several dermatologists across Mumbai over the last 10 years, but Dr. Pooja Chopra truly stands out. Her knowledge, precision, and genuine care for her patients make all the difference.

Unlike many dermatologists who delegate procedures or overcharge without real results, Dr. Pooja personally performs every treatment with utmost skill and attention. Her approach is natural, thoughtful, and rooted in deep expertise. You can tell she wants the best outcome for every patient.

Her team of girls are also incredibly warm, professional, and efficient. They make every visit feel comfortable and well-organized.

If you’re looking for a dermatologist who combines authentic care with exceptional skill, I can’t recommend Dr. Pooja Chopra annd her team enough.

featured_reviews.name: Komal Shetty
featured_reviews.review_text:
I visited Dr. Pooja Chopra for acne, pigmentation, hair fall, and a very dry scalp - and I’m honestly so happy with my results! I started seeing noticeable improvements after just two sessions, which felt like such a relief after struggling with these issues for so long.

Dr. Pooja’s expertise really shines through. She explains everything clearly, makes you feel completely at ease, and you can tell she genuinely cares about her patients.

The staff is equally wonderful - warm, helpful, and super organised. Every visit feels smooth and positive.

Overall, I’m extremely happy with my experience and truly grateful for the progress I’ve seen already!

featured_reviews.name: Shalini Singh
featured_reviews.review_text:
I first started visiting Dr. Pooja back in 2022 and was immediately impressed by how thoroughly she understood my skin. Life got in the way and I had a long gap where I wasn't visiting any dermatologist, but when I finally decided to go back, I didn't even think twice about where to go. Dr. Chopra was the only name in my mind.
Coming back confirmed exactly why. She has a rare ability to truly understand each patient's skin individually, not a generic protocol, but a genuine understanding of what your skin needs and why. Her calm and composed demeanour makes even complicated skin concerns feel manageable. You never feel rushed or dismissed, she takes the time to explain, listen, and adjust.
The team at her clinic deserves a mention too, they are warm, friendly, and make the entire experience comfortable from the moment you walk in.
After trying to manage my skin concerns without proper guidance for so long, coming back to Dr. Chopra felt like finally being in the right place. If you are looking for a dermatologist who combines expertise with genuine care and patience, look no further.

featured_reviews.name: Shubham Dhavse
featured_reviews.review_text:
I visited this clinic for a Skin Booster Injection treatment and the experience was excellent. The dermatologist was very professional and explained the whole procedure, benefits, and aftercare in detail.

The clinic was hygienic and well organized, and the staff were polite and supportive. The treatment was done very carefully and with minimal discomfort. After the procedure, my skin felt more hydrated and looked healthier.

Overall, I’m very satisfied and would recommend this clinic to anyone looking for skin booster treatments.

Thank you Dr pooja chopra

featured_reviews.name: Durva More
featured_reviews.review_text: I’m really happy with how Dr. Pooja has taken care of my skin over the years. I initially started consulting her for adult acne and acne scars, and the journey since then has been very reassuring.Over time, the focus has shifted to overall skin health, and I like how the approach is not just about quick fixes but taking care of the skin inside out. Now my skin feels healthier, looks clearer, and has a natural glow. It’s been a very consistent and positive experience.

featured_reviews.name: Maheshwari Patil
featured_reviews.review_text:
Got lip fillers done recently with Dr Pooja Chopra and I’m really happy with how they turned out. I was a bit unsure at first because I didn’t want anything that looked fake or too obvious. But this is exactly what I was hoping for—my lips look fuller, fit my face really well, and just make my features look better overall.Best part is they don’t look “done” at all. Most people can’t even tell, they just say I look good or a bit more fresh.
Super happy with the result.

And said now the nurse will apply and cream and take you for face laser. To which i instantly reacted and said I’m not here for laser but only for cleanup. To which she forced me a lot to get face laser done and that’s the only way to get my skin better for the engagement. To which i tried explaining her that doc I’m here only for cleanup. My skin is too sensitive and i don’t want to go ahead with any laser treatment. She literally said I’m the doctor and how can you tell me no. To which i again politely told her my skin is very sensitive and i don’t want any laser. And i mentioned i easily get reaction to which she said, yes after laser you’ll get acne breakout. And i again told her it’s my engagement i cannot afford to get a acne breakout on purpose. She said that can he taken care of. We will again do a treatment for that.
So i said that genuinely doesn’t makes any sense to do something on the face which will give me acne breakout. And i said doctor I’m too scared for all this and i don’t wish to do it.
She got pissed and just made a face and left. I waited there thinking she would return to which the nurses came there and said go wash your face your cleanup is done and now we’re taking you inside for laser. To which i again told them I’ve already said i don’t want any laser. To which those nurses kept on rudely speaking why are you here if you don’t want to do the treatment ? I told them i was not here for any treatment but for only cleanup. I washed my face and they said you’ve been called to the reception, so i went. And 2 nurses sitting on the desk started explaining again how and what all they’ll be doing now for laser and how i have to go inside the laser room. By now i was not sure what was happening and i told them again i don’t want laser and I’ve explained the same quite a few times. To which they said but you’ve to do what doctor says and treatment is very important. I just left from there and waited patiently for my fiancé’s turn. As soon as the doctor Meena came she popped his pimples too and he had some queries regarding his skin to which when he started asking or explaining her. She said “ jab vo kuch nahi karva rahi hain or sun rahi hai, tum kya sunoge” and she just left in the middle. And never came back.
After 15mins she just came and said both of you are very darpok. This is not how life works, there has to be one amongst the couple who has to be strong.

So just because we denied the treatment she was forcing us ? We are darpok ??
She clearly just wanted to mint money. Not giving a Damn about the patient and patient’s requirement. And she’s suggesting a bride to be to get a treatment done which will give her acne breakout. And then again do a treatment for acne ?? What’s wrong with doctor ??

And i have paid 5k in total for just 5mins and 2-3 pimple popping session for  both of us.

Please be aware. You go for 1 treatment and without your consent she will start another. And make you pay for it.
